outcomes_u2.family_error: Lemma FW-U, response part: <= 2 coverage-failure events per model; 3 x 2 x 1/300 = 0.02 <= 0.05 (protocol 4.1: conservative at the unchanged alpha)
outcomes_u2.scope_clause: Pairs are natural histories of world w* that share their last four symbols; each arm is a draw from the process. Any predictor or code that depends only on the last four symbols has zero effect on these pairs, so every effect stated here depends on the history before the last four symbols. The share outcomes concern the frozen, nuisance-excluding linear code defined by the FIT fit and projector of the stage-C chart phase. They do not exclude predictive use of beyond-four information in excluded directions, higher harmonics, interactions or other encodings.

licences.RESPONDS: In k of the 3 stage-C models (masters ...), when only the history before the last four symbols changes, the next-symbol prediction at position 32 moves in the direction of the oracle's change by more than 0.30 of the oracle's own discrimination: theta-hat = ..., one-sided (1 - 1/300) lower bounds .... A predictor reading only the last four symbols would show theta = 0 on these pairs. The prediction therefore depends on earlier history, aligned with the belief.
licences.WEAK_RESPONSE / RESP_POSITIVE_BELOW_MARG: ... the prediction moves in the oracle's direction (lower bound above 0) but by less than 0.30 of the oracle's discrimination [WEAK: and by more than 0.10]. This is a positive finding below the response margin; it is neither RESPONDS nor evidence of a negligible response.
licences.LOW_RESPONSE: ... the signed oracle-aligned response is certified below 0.10 of the oracle's (it may be negative). The circle carries beyond-four information (stage C), but these predictions move little with it in the oracle's direction.
licences.LOW_RESPONSE_not_licensed: that the prediction is a function of the last four symbols only (orthogonal or cancelling movement is not excluded)
licences.MIXED / INCONCLUSIVE: Only the per-model results, and the statement 'not evidence for or against use'.
licences.SHARE_INCONCLUSIVE_ORACLE_FEASIBILITY: The share question (how much of the response runs through the circle code) was not assessed: the oracle-only feasibility stage found that the share arrays could not be powered within the registered precision ladder, so the share family was dropped before any model was measured (protocol 4.1, S3). This is not evidence for or against use of the circle code.

outcomes_u2.disclosure: Track U follows stage C (SUPPORT in 3/3: the chart phase carries beyond-four information) and C2/C2ND (circle code used at the readout in the E4 models of world w0). Track U's histories, code fits and decisions are its own. Its thresholds are C2's owner-approved lines, unchanged; the charts, site and models are stage C's, unchanged. No threshold, margin or construction constant was set from any track-U or stage-C value. The oracle feasibility stage changed only cost forecasts.
